text: ​我哋​嚟​自​世界​各​地，有​唔​同​嘅​文化​背景，講​唔​同​嘅​語言。但係，我哋​非常​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​嘅​目標。最​重要​嘅​係，我哋​都​渴望​榮耀​耶和華，耶和華​就係​聖經​所​講​嘅​上帝，佢​係​萬物​嘅​創造主。我哋​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我哋​每​個​人​都​經常​付出​時間​幫助​其他人​認識​聖經​同​上帝​嘅​王國。由於​我哋​為​耶和華​上帝​同​佢​嘅​王國​作​見證，傳講​上帝​同​佢​王國​嘅​真理，所以​我哋​稱​為​耶和華見證人。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the raining morning of the 30th of January of 2022, at the cafe, I was drinking my iced black tea. My friend Don walked to a front table, as we discussed his electronic-book reader, which he has had for over ten years. I have a similar device. Later, a handsome black-haired bearded man, maybe an Arab, approached the counter. He was wearing a black T-shirt and grey rugby pants. He had very hairy arms. Afterwards, I went to the pizzeria.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 1 jyut6 30 hou6 ge3 lok6 jyu5 ziu1 zou2，hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 jam2 gan2 ngo5 ge3 bing1 hung4 caa4。ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 Don haang4 heoi3 jat1 zoeng1 cin4 toi2，dong1 ngo5 dei6 tou2 leon6 gan2 keoi5 ge3 din6 zi2 syu1 jyut6 duk6 hei3，keoi5 ji5 ging1 jau5 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4。hau6 loi4，jat1 go3 leng3 zai2 ge3 hak1 faat3 wu4 sou1 naam4 jan2，ho2 nang4 hai6 go3 aa3 laai1 baak3 jan4，zau2 gan6 zo2 go3 gwai6 toi2。keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 hak1 sik1 ge3 T seot1 tung4 fui1 sik1 ge3 laam2 kau4 fu3。zi1 hau6，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 gaan1 bok6 beng2 pou2。
text: 喺2022年1月30號嘅落雨朝早，喺咖啡館，我飲緊我嘅冰紅茶。我個朋友 Don 行去一張前枱，當我哋討論緊佢嘅電子書閱讀器，佢已經有咗十幾年。後來，一個靚仔嘅黑髮鬍鬚男人，可能係個阿拉伯人，走近咗個櫃檯。佢着住件黑色嘅 T 恤同灰色嘅欖球褲。之後，我去咗間薄餅舖。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 9th of June of 2013. I opine that Esperanto will live on for a long, long time. It is a good language for talking to someone from abroad. I opine that Lojban is probably better in the written form. I prefer reading and writing it than speaking and listening. In any case, Lojban words are fun to enunciate. Both Lojban and Esperanto have prayerful sounds. I must reveal a secret about my current desire that if I were a monolingual, I would prefer to be a Lojbanic monolingual. That way is how I feel today. But in reality, I am really very multilingual. I know a rainbow of different languages now.

jyutping: hai2 2013 nin4 6 jyut6 9 hou6。ngo5 jing6 wai4 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 wui5 sang1 cyun4 hou2 noi6 hou2 noi6。ni1 go3 hai6 tung4 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 jan4 king1 gai2 ge3 hou2 jyu5 jin4。ngo5 jing6 wai4 Lojban ho2 nang4 hai2 syu1 min2 jing4 sik1 soeng6 hai6 hou2 di1。ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 tung4 se2，ji4 m4 hai6 gong2 tung4 teng1。mou4 leon6 dim2 joeng2， Lojban ge3 zi6 dou1 hai6 hou2 waan2 ge3，daan6 hai6 Lojban tung4 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 dou1 jau5 kei4 tou2 ge3 sing1 jam1。ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tau3 lou6 jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 juk6 mong6 ge3 bei3 mat6，zau6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 daan1 jyu5 jan4 si6，ngo5 ning4 jyun2 hai6 jat1 go3 lok3 ji1 baa1 nei4 jyu5 daan1 jyu5 jan4 si6。ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 ge3 gam2 gok3。daan6 hai6 jin6 sat6 jap6 min6，ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 do1 jyu5 jin4。
text: 喺2013年6月9號。我認為世界語會生存好耐好耐。呢個係同外國嘅人傾偈嘅好語言。我認為 Lojban 可能喺書面形式上係好啲。我鍾意睇同寫，而唔係講同聽。無論點樣， Lojban 嘅字都係好玩嘅，但係 Lojban 同世界語都有祈禱嘅聲音。我一定要透露一個關於我而家嘅慾望嘅秘密，就係如果我係一個單語人士，我寧願係一個洛伊巴尼語單語人士。呢個就係我今日嘅感覺。但係現實入面，我真係好多語言。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Among the familiar things that he would encounter would be creatures recognizably human yet in his view grotesque. While he himself laboured under the weight of his own body, these giants would be easily striding. He would consider them very sturdy, often thick-set, folk, but he would be compelled to allow them grace of movement and even beauty of proportion. The longer he stayed with them the more beauty he would see in them, and the less complacently would he regard his own type. Some of these fantastic men and women he would find covered with fur, hirsute, or mole-velvet, revealing the underlying muscles. Others would display brown, yellow or ruddy skin, and yet others a translucent ash-green, warmed by the under-flowing blood. As a species, though we are all human, we are extremely variable in body and mind, so variable that superficially we seem to be not one species but many.

text: 佢會遇到嘅熟悉嘅事物當中，有啲係可以認出係人類嘅生物，但係喺佢嘅睇法入面，佢哋嘅生物係奇怪嘅。當佢自己喺自己身體嘅重量下勞累嘅時候，呢啲巨人就會好容易噉行。佢會覺得佢哋好堅固，通常都係厚身嘅，民間，但係佢會被迫容許佢哋有動作嘅優雅，甚至係比例嘅美感。佢同佢哋一齊嘅時間越長，佢就會喺佢哋身上見到越多嘅美，同埋佢會越唔自滿噉睇自己嘅類型。佢會發現呢啲夢幻嘅男人同女人當中有啲被毛皮、毛茸茸或者黑斑絨毛覆蓋住，露出咗底下嘅肌肉。其他人會展現出啡色、黃色或者紅潤嘅皮膚，而其他人就會呈現出半透明嘅灰綠色，由流動嘅血液所暖化。作為一個物種，雖然我哋都係人類，但係我哋嘅身體同心靈都係極度變化，變化到表面上我哋似乎唔係一個物種，而係好多物種。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Later in the morning, before 10, I returned to Tim Hortons. I walked as I usually did. At a corner of a long table with a graphic of an ice hockey rink, I was eating an Herb and Garlic Pastry whilst drinking a Specialty Chai Tea with Oat Milk. Pushpak the South Asian vendor was there, then. I saw my friend Leo the Filipino with a big bag of groceries for "two weeks' worth." He said that he still ate Filipino-style, despite being here in "the Great White North." There was a dark-haired technical man with a strange Euro-like accent using a sophisticated ultramodern rotating black camera on a tripod for taking "measurements for insurance." He mentioned the word "lighter." At home, I listened to music from a radio app on my tablet: Happy '70s, '80s & '90s Pop Rock, House: Deep to Future, Baroque, Zouk Hits, and Southeast Asia Psychedelics. I was earlier today making contributions to articles in the Tagalog Wikipedia. It was the 23rd of January of 2025.

text: 朝早十點前，我返咗去 Tim Hortons ，我好似平時噉行，喺一張長枱嘅一個角落，上面有一個冰上曲棍球場嘅圖案，我食緊個香草同蒜蓉酥皮，同時飲緊一杯特式柴茶同燕麥奶，然後我見到我嘅朋友，佢仲係度食咗兩星期嘅食物菲律賓式，儘管喺呢度「大白北」。有個黑髮嘅技術人員，有個奇怪嘅歐洲口音，用一個精緻嘅超現代旋轉黑色相機喺三腳架上面做「保險測量」。佢喺屋企，我喺平板電腦上面聽緊個收音機應用程式嘅音樂：快樂嘅70年代、80年代同90年代嘅流行搖滾、 House: Deep to Future 、 Zouk 酒吧熱門歌曲，同埋東南亞迷幻藥。我今日早啲喺塔加洛文維基百科度做文章。嗰日係2025年1月23號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Of the busy Utopias which I have been describing, a few were already established even before the birth of the Other Earth, a larger number flourished before our own planet was formed, but many of the most important of these worlds are temporally located in an age far future to us, an age long after the destruction of the final human race.

jyutping: hai2 ngo5 jat1 zik6 miu4 seot6 gan2 ge3 faan4 mong4 ge3 wu1 tok3 bong1 dong1 zung1，jau5 gei2 go3 sam6 zi3 hai2 ling6 jat1 go3 dei6 kau4 daan3 sang1 zi1 cin4 ji5 ging1 gin3 laap6 zo2，gang3 do1 ge3 hai6 hai2 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing1 kau4 jing4 sing4 zi1 cin4 pung4 but6 faat3 zin2，daan6 hai6 ni1 di1 sai3 gaai3 dong1 zung1 hou2 do1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 sai3 gaai3 dou1 zaam6 si4 wai6 jyu1 ngo5 dei6 jyun5 jyun5 mei6 loi4 ge3 si4 doi6，zik1 hai6 hai2 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 go3 jan4 leoi6 bei6 wai2 mit6 zi1 hau6 hou2 noi6 ge3 si4 doi6。
text: 喺我一直描述緊嘅繁忙嘅烏托邦當中，有幾個甚至喺另一個地球誕生之前已經建立咗，更多嘅係喺我哋自己嘅星球形成之前蓬勃發展，但係呢啲世界當中好多最重要嘅世界都暫時位於我哋遠遠未來嘅時代，即係喺最後一個人類被毀滅之後好耐嘅時代。
